button.name: luminous_box_close
button.tool_tip: Close the panel. Click a tab to open it again.

panel.label: Scene
panel.name: luminous_light
panel.tool_tip: The scene itself: sky and sun, light in the air, shadows, and fixes for reflections and hair.

text.name: light_env_title
text.tool_tip: The sky and the sun. Only you see them.

button.name: light_env_personal
button.tool_tip: Opens Personal Lighting, for the sky's own settings: colours, haze, clouds, sun and moon.

combo_box.name: env_sky
combo_box.tool_tip: The sky you see: the region's own, one of Luminous's, or one of your PBR skies from inventory. Only you see it.

slider.name: env_sun_azimuth
slider.tool_tip: Where the sun is around you. Turn it until the light falls on the face as you want: from the side for shape, from behind for a glow in the hair.

slider.name: env_sun_elevation
slider.tool_tip: How high the sun is: low for warm light and long shadows, high for short ones.

text.name: light_atmos_title
text.tool_tip: Light you can see in the air: haze, beams and rays. Shows most looking toward the light.

button.name: vol_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings. The slider beside the name sets them too.

text.name: volumetric_name
text.tool_tip: Sunlight glowing in the air, with beams where things cast shadows. Shows most looking toward the sun. Needs Shadows on in Graphics preferences.

slider.name: vol_amount
slider.tool_tip: From a faint glow to thick haze.

slider.label: Density
slider.name: volumetric_density
slider.tool_tip: How hazy the air is: 0.005 a glow, 0.02 hazy, 0.04 and up fog.

slider.label: Toward the sun
slider.name: volumetric_anisotropy
slider.tool_tip: How much the glow gathers round the sun. With the sun behind you, lower shows more.

slider.label: Distance (m)
slider.name: volumetric_distance
slider.tool_tip: How far from the camera the air glows, in metres.

text.name: volumetric_needs_shadows
text.tool_tip: Volumetric light needs shadows: with Shadows set to None in Graphics preferences it shows nothing.

button.name: beams_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings. The slider beside the name sets them too.

text.name: beams_name
text.tool_tip: Beams in the air from projector lights. Needs a projector shining into view; best in the dark.

slider.name: beams_amount
slider.tool_tip: How strongly projector beams show.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: beams_density
slider.tool_tip: How bright the beams are; 0 none.

slider.label: Toward the light
slider.name: beams_anisotropy
slider.tool_tip: Low shows a beam well from the side; high mostly when you look into the light.

button.name: shafts_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings. The slider beside the name sets them too.

text.name: shafts_name
text.tool_tip: Rays fanning out from the sun or moon. Needs it in or near the picture, partly hidden by leaves, a roof or the like.

slider.name: shafts_amount
slider.tool_tip: How strong and long the rays are.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: shafts_strength
slider.tool_tip: How bright the rays are; 0 none.

slider.label: Length
slider.name: shafts_length
slider.tool_tip: How far the rays reach from the sun.

slider.label: Softness
slider.name: shafts_softness
slider.tool_tip: Low: crisp, separate rays. High: a soft fan.

text.name: light_shadows_title
text.tool_tip: How shadows and shade fall. Often subtle until you look closely.

slider.label: Shadow strength
slider.name: shadow_strength
slider.tool_tip: How dark shadows are: 1 full, lower lets some light through, 0 none.

button.name: softsh_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: soft_shadows_name
text.tool_tip: Shadows sharp where things touch and softer further away, as real ones. Needs Shadows on in Graphics preferences.

slider.name: softsh_amount
slider.tool_tip: How soft shadows get: 0 sharp, 1 a clear day, 2.5 a hazy day, higher softer. Shadows from high up, as leaves overhead, soften most.

slider.label: Edge blur
slider.name: softsh_edge_blur
slider.tool_tip: Softens shadow edges a little, live and in renders; 0 none.

button.name: contact_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: contact_name
text.tool_tip: Small, sharp shadows where things touch: fingers on skin, feet on the floor. Needs Shadows on in Graphics preferences.

slider.name: contact_strength
slider.tool_tip: How dark contact shadows are; 0 none.

slider.label: Length
slider.name: contact_length
slider.tool_tip: How far contact shadows reach: short where things touch, longer for folds and gaps.

button.name: ao_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings. The slider beside the name sets them too.

text.name: gtao_name
text.tool_tip: Soft darkening in creases, corners and where things meet. Shows most in shade.

slider.name: ao_amount
slider.tool_tip: How deep and wide the darkening is.

slider.label: Radius
slider.name: gtao_radius
slider.tool_tip: How far the darkening reaches: small for fine creases, larger for room corners.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: gtao_strength
slider.tool_tip: How dark the darkening is; 0 none.

slider.label: Soften
slider.name: gtao_soften
slider.tool_tip: How smooth the darkening is: low crisp, high soft.

slider.label: On lamps
slider.name: gtao_lights
slider.tool_tip: Darkens creases in the light of lamps and projectors too, as in a studio without sun. 0 only the light of sky and surroundings, as a camera would see it.

text.name: light_enhance_title
text.tool_tip: Where Second Life draws things wrong: reflections in shiny surfaces, and see-through hair in front of leaves.

text.name: ssr_name
text.tool_tip: Cleaner reflections in shiny floors and surfaces. Only in the rendered picture. Needs Screen Space Reflections on in Graphics preferences.

button.name: alpha_sort_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: alpha_sort_name
text.tool_tip: See-through hair and eyelashes in front of leaves and other see-through things: the leaves show through the hair instead of the sky. Exact in the rendered picture. Off draws them as Second Life does.

check_box.label: Faint layers as in Second Life
check_box.name: alpha_sort_faint_sl
check_box.tool_tip: Body hair, beards, tattoos and other faint layers over each other: drawn as Second Life draws them, where the first hides those behind it, so they look as you are used to. Off, every layer counts, a little denser. Hair over leaves and fur is sorted either way.

text.name: light_lights_title
text.tool_tip: Which lights are drawn.

check_box.label: Attached lights
check_box.name: face_lights
check_box.tool_tip: Lights worn by avatars: face lights, lights in hair or jewellery. Off: only the scene's lights and the sun.

button.label: Reset scene
button.name: light_defaults
button.tool_tip: Put this tab back as Luminous ships it.

button.name: pause_scene_light_defaults
button.tool_tip: Pause everything that moves (animations, water, clouds, particles) while you move the camera freely. Click again to go on.

button.label: Preview
button.name: light_defaults_preview
button.tool_tip: A quick picture with every effect at full quality: four frames at the window's size, without the margin or Full detail's wait. Render then makes the full picture of the same moment.

button.label: Render
button.name: light_defaults_capture
button.tool_tip: Render the picture now, with the Render tab's settings.

text.name: adjust_tone_title
text.tool_tip: How very bright and dark light fits into the picture.

text.name: look_tonemap_label
text.tool_tip: How bright light turns into colour. AgX keeps a bright sky's colour instead of white; AgX Punchy adds contrast.

combo_box.name: look_tonemapper
combo_box.tool_tip: How bright light turns into colour. AgX keeps a bright sky's colour instead of white; AgX Punchy adds contrast.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: look_tonemap_mix
slider.tool_tip: How much the tonemapper is used; at 0 bright parts turn white.

text.name: look_legacy_note
text.tool_tip: This is a legacy (Windlight) sky, so tonemapping does nothing here. Tick Auto-adjust legacy skies below to change that.

check_box.label: Auto-adjust legacy skies
check_box.name: look_legacy_sky
check_box.tool_tip: Lights a legacy (Windlight) sky as a modern one, so tonemapping works. It changes the sky's light too.

text.name: adjust_adjust_title
text.tool_tip: Brightness and contrast, as in a photo app.

slider.label: Exposure
slider.name: look_exposure
slider.tool_tip: Brighter or darker: +1 twice as bright, -1 half.

slider.label: Contrast
slider.name: look_contrast
slider.tool_tip: Higher for more contrast, lower for a flatter picture.

slider.label: Highlights
slider.name: look_highlights
slider.tool_tip: Left darkens bright areas, such as a washed-out sky; right brightens them.

slider.label: Shadows
slider.name: look_shadows
slider.tool_tip: Right brightens dark areas, such as a face in shade; left deepens them.

slider.label: Whites
slider.name: look_whites
slider.tool_tip: The brightest parts only: left keeps a white dress or sky from burning out.

slider.label: Blacks
slider.name: look_blacks
slider.tool_tip: The deepest shadows only: left deeper, right lifted for a faded look.

text.name: adjust_detail_title
text.tool_tip: How much texture and shape stand out.

slider.label: Clarity
slider.name: look_clarity
slider.tool_tip: Right brings out texture in fabric, wood and skin; left softens it for a gentle portrait.

text.name: sharpen_name
text.tool_tip: Sharpens fine detail, without halos.

slider.name: look_sharpening
slider.tool_tip: How much fine detail is sharpened; 0 none.

button.label: Reset tone
button.name: look_reset
button.tool_tip: Put this tab back as Luminous ships it.

button.name: pause_scene_look_reset
button.tool_tip: Pause everything that moves (animations, water, clouds, particles) while you move the camera freely. Click again to go on.

button.label: Preview
button.name: look_reset_preview
button.tool_tip: A quick picture with every effect at full quality: four frames at the window's size, without the margin or Full detail's wait. Render then makes the full picture of the same moment.

button.label: Render
button.name: look_reset_capture
button.tool_tip: Render the picture now, with the Render tab's settings.

text.name: colour_basic_title
text.tool_tip: How colourful the picture is, its white balance and its grading.

button.name: colour_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: colour_label
text.tool_tip: Left toward grey, right more colourful.

slider.name: colour_amount
slider.tool_tip: Left toward grey, right more colourful.

slider.label: Saturation
slider.name: look_saturation
slider.tool_tip: Colour everywhere: 0 grey, 1 as is, 2 double.

slider.label: Vibrance
slider.name: look_vibrance
slider.tool_tip: Adds colour where there is little and leaves vivid colours alone.

button.name: wb_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: wb_label
text.tool_tip: Cooler (left, blue) or warmer (right, amber) light.

slider.name: wb_amount
slider.tool_tip: Cooler (left, blue) or warmer (right, amber) light.

slider.label: Tint
slider.name: look_tint
slider.tool_tip: Toward green (left) or magenta (right), to correct a colour cast.

button.name: split_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: split_label
text.tool_tip: Cool shadows and warm highlights (right), or the reverse (left).

slider.name: split_amount
slider.tool_tip: Cool shadows and warm highlights (right), or the reverse (left).

slider.label: Shadows warmth
slider.name: look_shadows_warmth
slider.tool_tip: Dark parts cooler (left) or warmer (right).

slider.label: Shadows tint
slider.name: look_shadows_tint
slider.tool_tip: Dark parts toward green (left) or magenta (right).

slider.label: Midtones warmth
slider.name: look_midtones_warmth
slider.tool_tip: Middle tones cooler (left) or warmer (right).

slider.label: Midtones tint
slider.name: look_midtones_tint
slider.tool_tip: Middle tones toward green (left) or magenta (right).

slider.label: Highlights warmth
slider.name: look_highlights_warmth
slider.tool_tip: Bright parts cooler (left) or warmer (right).

slider.label: Highlights tint
slider.name: look_highlights_tint
slider.tool_tip: Bright parts toward green (left) or magenta (right).

text.name: colour_hsl_title
text.tool_tip: Change some colours only, black and white, and colour tables.

button.name: hsl_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: hsl_label
text.tool_tip: Change one range of colours: pick it under the arrow, then set its hue, saturation and lightness.

text.name: look_hsl_label
text.tool_tip: Which colours the sliders below change.

combo_box.name: look_hsl_range
combo_box.tool_tip: Which colours the sliders below change.

slider.label: Hue
slider.name: look_hsl_hue
slider.tool_tip: Shifts the chosen colours toward their neighbours, such as greens toward yellow or aqua.

slider.label: Saturation
slider.name: look_hsl_sat
slider.tool_tip: More or less colour in the chosen colours; -1 grey.

slider.label: Lightness
slider.name: look_hsl_lum
slider.tool_tip: The chosen colours lighter or darker: a darker sky, lighter skin.

button.name: mono_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: mono_label
text.tool_tip: From colour (0) to black and white (1).

slider.name: mono_amount
slider.tool_tip: From colour (0) to black and white (1).

text.name: look_filter_label
text.tool_tip: As a camera filter for black and white: red darkens a blue sky, green lightens leaves.

combo_box.name: look_filter
combo_box.tool_tip: As a camera filter for black and white: red darkens a blue sky, green lightens leaves.

slider.label: Sepia
slider.name: look_sepia
slider.tool_tip: Warm brown tones, as an old print.

text.name: lut_label
text.tool_tip: A ready-made colour look. Pick one here, or add your own .cube file with the plus.

combo_box.name: look_lut
combo_box.tool_tip: The colour look. None turns it off.

button.name: look_lut_load
button.tool_tip: Add your own .cube colour table, such as one exported from Lightroom, Photoshop or Resolve.

text.name: look_lut_label
text.tool_tip: How much of the colour look; 0 none.

slider.name: look_lut_strength
slider.tool_tip: How much of the colour look; 0 none.

button.label: Reset colour
button.name: colour_defaults
button.tool_tip: Put this tab back: colours untouched, no colour look.

button.name: pause_scene_colour_defaults
button.tool_tip: Pause everything that moves (animations, water, clouds, particles) while you move the camera freely. Click again to go on.

button.label: Preview
button.name: colour_defaults_preview
button.tool_tip: A quick picture with every effect at full quality: four frames at the window's size, without the margin or Full detail's wait. Render then makes the full picture of the same moment.

button.label: Render
button.name: colour_defaults_capture
button.tool_tip: Render the picture now, with the Render tab's settings.

text.name: lens_focus_title
text.tool_tip: What is sharp and what is blurred, as with a real lens.

button.name: dof_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: dof_name
text.tool_tip: Blurs what is nearer or further than the focus. Enhance, under the arrow, blurs as a real lens. Alt-click to focus.

slider.name: dof_amount
slider.tool_tip: Right blurs more, left keeps more sharp.

text.name: lens_blur_name
text.tool_tip: Blur as a real lens gives it: lights open into discs, and the background never bleeds onto a sharp subject.

check_box.label: Blur the foreground
check_box.name: dof_front
check_box.tool_tip: Blur the foreground too, not only the background.

slider.label: Aperture (f-number)
slider.name: dof_fnumber
slider.tool_tip: Lower blurs more. Blur is strongest with a close subject and a far background.

slider.label: Maximum blur
slider.name: dof_max_blur
slider.tool_tip: The most blur allowed. Raise it if a lower F-number stops making a difference.

slider.label: Aperture blades
slider.name: dof_blades
slider.tool_tip: The shape of blurred lights: 0 round, 3 to 9 a shape with that many sides.

check_box.label: Focus follows the mouse
check_box.name: dof_follows_mouse
check_box.tool_tip: Focus where the mouse rests, instead of where you Alt-click.

text.name: lens_optical_title
text.tool_tip: What a real lens adds: dark corners, glow, colour fringes and more.

button.name: vig_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: vignette_name
text.tool_tip: Darker corners, as from a lens.

slider.name: vig_amount
slider.tool_tip: How dark the corners get.

slider.label: Size
slider.name: vignette_size
slider.tool_tip: Low reaches toward the centre; high keeps it to the corners.

slider.label: Softness
slider.name: vignette_softness
slider.tool_tip: 0 a hard edge, higher a gentler fade.

slider.label: Roundness
slider.name: vignette_roundness
slider.tool_tip: 1 a circle; 0 follows the picture's shape.

button.name: bloom_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: bloom_name
text.tool_tip: A soft glow round bright lights: lamps, windows, the sun on water.

slider.name: bloom_amount
slider.tool_tip: How strong the glow is; above 0.3 a dreamy glow.

slider.label: Size
slider.name: bloom_size
slider.tool_tip: How far the glow reaches.

button.name: object_glow_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: object_glow_name
text.tool_tip: The glow builders give lamps, neon and screens.

slider.name: object_glow_amount
slider.tool_tip: How strong the glow round glowing objects is.

slider.label: Width
slider.name: object_glow_width
slider.tool_tip: How far the glow spreads.

text.name: ca_name
text.tool_tip: Red and blue fringes toward the picture's edges, as from a simple lens.

slider.name: ca_amount
slider.tool_tip: How far the colours split at the edges.

text.name: halation_name
text.tool_tip: A warm red-orange glow round very bright edges, as on film.

slider.name: luminousphotohalation_amount
slider.tool_tip: A warm red-orange glow round very bright edges, as on film.

button.name: anamorphic_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: anamorphic_name
text.tool_tip: Streaks through bright lights, as an anamorphic lens draws them.

slider.name: luminousphotoanamorphic_amount
slider.tool_tip: Streaks through bright lights, as an anamorphic lens draws them.

text.name: anamorphic_tint_label
text.tool_tip: The streaks' colour: blue as the classic anamorphic lenses. Click the swatch to choose another; how bright it is does not matter.

color_swatch.name: anamorphic_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: The streaks' colour: blue as the classic anamorphic lenses. Click the swatch to choose another; how bright it is does not matter.

button.name: lens_flare_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: lens_flare_name
text.tool_tip: Flare in the lens from bright lights: ghosts, a halo, a starburst. Needs the sun or very bright lights in view.

slider.name: luminousphotolensflare_amount
slider.tool_tip: Flare in the lens from bright lights: ghosts, a halo, a starburst. Needs the sun or very bright lights in view.

slider.label: Ghosts
slider.name: lens_flare_ghosts
slider.tool_tip: Copies of bright lights mirrored across the picture; 0 none.

slider.label: Halo
slider.name: lens_flare_halo
slider.tool_tip: A faint ring when a bright light is near the middle; 0 none.

slider.label: Starburst
slider.name: lens_flare_starburst
slider.tool_tip: Spikes from bright points; 0 none.

slider.label: Star blur
slider.name: lens_flare_star_blur
slider.tool_tip: Softens the starburst's spikes into soft rays; 0 sharp lines.

slider.label: Lens dirt
slider.name: lens_flare_dirt
slider.tool_tip: Specks on the lens, seen against bright light; 0 a clean lens.

slider.label: Variation
slider.name: lens_flare_variation
slider.tool_tip: A different flare for each value: try a few.

slider.label: Amplify
slider.name: lens_flare_amplify
slider.tool_tip: More flare, from dimmer lights too.

text.name: distortion_name
text.tool_tip: Bends straight lines: right bows them out (wide lens), left pulls them in (long lens).

slider.name: luminousphotodistortion_amount
slider.tool_tip: Bends straight lines: right bows them out (wide lens), left pulls them in (long lens).

text.name: lens_film_title
text.tool_tip: Film grain, a worn print and light leaks.

button.name: grain_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: grain_name
text.tool_tip: Film grain: 0 none, 1 heavy. Easiest to see on smooth areas such as sky.

slider.name: grain_amount
slider.tool_tip: Film grain: 0 none, 1 heavy. Easiest to see on smooth areas such as sky.

slider.label: Grain size
slider.name: look_grain_size
slider.tool_tip: Fine (1) to coarse (4) grain.

button.name: worn_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: worn_name
text.tool_tip: Makes the picture look like an old, handled print: fading, stains, dust, scratches and worn edges. Not tied to the light.

slider.name: worn_amount
slider.tool_tip: Makes the picture look like an old, handled print: fading, stains, dust, scratches and worn edges. Not tied to the light.

slider.label: Dust
slider.name: worn_dust
slider.tool_tip: Light and dark specks; 0 none.

slider.label: Scratches
slider.name: worn_scratches
slider.tool_tip: Thin scratches across the picture; 0 none.

slider.label: Fading, stains
slider.name: worn_stains
slider.tool_tip: Pale patches, brown stains and spots; 0 none.

slider.label: Worn edges
slider.name: worn_edges
slider.tool_tip: Edges and rounded corners worn down to the paper; 0 none.

slider.label: Paper
slider.name: worn_paper
slider.tool_tip: The paper's texture, seen most in light parts; 0 none.

slider.label: Variation
slider.name: worn_variation
slider.tool_tip: Another pattern of wear for each step.

button.name: light_leak_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: light_leak_name
text.tool_tip: Light in from the edge of the frame, as on film that let light in. Not tied to the scene's light.

slider.name: light_leak_amount
slider.tool_tip: Light in from the edge of the frame, as on film that let light in. Not tied to the scene's light.

text.name: light_leak_colour_label
text.tool_tip: The leak's colour where it is faint, deep red as Luminous ships; stronger it goes on toward white, as on film. Click the swatch to choose another.

color_swatch.name: light_leak_colour
color_swatch.tool_tip: The leak's colour where it is faint, deep red as Luminous ships; stronger it goes on toward white, as on film. Click the swatch to choose another.

slider.label: Where
slider.name: light_leak_place
slider.tool_tip: Where it comes in, once round the frame: 0 the right edge, 0.25 the top, 0.5 the left, 0.75 the bottom.

slider.label: Size
slider.name: light_leak_size
slider.tool_tip: How far it reaches into the picture.

slider.label: Hardness
slider.name: light_leak_hardness
slider.tool_tip: A soft glow (0) to a band down the edge with a sharp inner side and stripes (1).

slider.label: Rainbow
slider.name: light_leak_rainbow
slider.tool_tip: Its colour turning through the rainbow further in; 0 none.

slider.label: Variation
slider.name: light_leak_variation
slider.tool_tip: Another shape for each step.

text.name: lens_digital_title
text.tool_tip: Effects of a digital image gone wrong.

button.name: glitch_options
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the finer settings.

text.name: glitch_name
text.tool_tip: Breaks the picture up like a damaged video: colours pulled apart, a worn tape's waver and static, ripples and scan lines.

slider.name: glitch_amount
slider.tool_tip: Breaks the picture up like a damaged video: colours pulled apart, a worn tape's waver and static, ripples and scan lines.

slider.label: Colour split
slider.name: glitch_split
slider.tool_tip: Red and cyan pulled apart; 0 none.

slider.label: VHS
slider.name: glitch_vhs
slider.tool_tip: A worn video tape: the picture wavers, soft bands of static, colour smeared sideways; 0 none.

slider.label: Waves
slider.name: glitch_waves
slider.tool_tip: Bands rippled in a sharp zigzag; 0 none.

slider.label: Scan lines
slider.name: glitch_lines
slider.tool_tip: Fine dark lines across, as on a screen. Shown where the picture has enough pixels for them.

slider.label: Line size
slider.name: glitch_line_size
slider.tool_tip: Fine (2) to coarse (8) scan lines, the same on the picture at any size.

slider.label: Variation
slider.name: glitch_variation
slider.tool_tip: Another pattern for each step.

button.label: Reset effects
button.name: lens_defaults
button.tool_tip: Put this tab back as Luminous ships it.

button.name: pause_scene_lens_defaults
button.tool_tip: Pause everything that moves (animations, water, clouds, particles) while you move the camera freely. Click again to go on.

button.label: Preview
button.name: lens_defaults_preview
button.tool_tip: A quick picture with every effect at full quality: four frames at the window's size, without the margin or Full detail's wait. Render then makes the full picture of the same moment.

button.label: Render
button.name: lens_defaults_capture
button.tool_tip: Render the picture now, with the Render tab's settings.

text.name: cap_size_title
text.tool_tip: How big the picture is.

text.name: snapshot_size_label
text.tool_tip: The picture's size: the window's, or double.

combo_box.name: snapshot_scale
combo_box.tool_tip: The picture's size: the window's, or double.

text.name: snapshot_shape_label
text.tool_tip: The picture's shape: the window's, or the middle of the view in another. The live view shows what a render keeps, the rest dimmed.

combo_box.name: snapshot_aspect
combo_box.tool_tip: The picture's shape: the window's, or the middle of the view in another. The live view shows what a render keeps, the rest dimmed.

button.name: snapshot_landscape
